why_not: The case series does not directly measure maternal prepregnancy BMI, and the comparison relies solely on proportions rather than rates.
statement: Maternal prepregnancy body mass index (BMI) differs between cases of sudden unexpected infant death (SUID) compared to other causes of infant death recorded in the same case series.
rationale: The design can compare proportions but cannot establish incidence or risk estimates due to a lack of denominator data and direct measurement issues.
prior_art: Maternal obesity is known to be a risk factor for SUID (suid_literature_abstracts.C10), but the role compared to other types of infant deaths remains unclear, necessitating further investigation.
